Hackathon
Categories
Choose your track and build innovative solutions on QIE blockchain
💰
DeFi & Financial Infrastructure
Build lending, savings, payments, treasury, remittance, and tokenized finance tools that move real value on-chain.
Examples:
Lending, Savings, Stablecoin Payroll, Remittance Rails, Tokenized Assets, Treasury
🤖
AI + Autonomous Agents
Build autonomous agents that transact, coordinate wallets, and execute real commerce workflows.
Examples:
Autonomous Wallets, AI Commerce, Agent Marketplaces, On-Chain Agent Ops
👥
Consumer Apps & Social
Create consumer products that deliver daily utility and engagement across communities, creators, and identity flows.
Examples:
Creator Economy, Messaging, Communities, Loyalty, Identity, Monetization
🛒
Commerce & Real World
Bring blockchain into real business operations for merchants, subscriptions, invoicing, ticketing, and supply chains.
Examples:
Merchant Payments, Invoicing, Ticketing, POS, Supply Chain, Subscriptions
🏗️
Developer Infrastructure & Tooling
Build tooling that improves the entire QIE ecosystem across wallets, SDKs, APIs, analytics, and security.
Examples:
SDKs, Wallet Tooling, APIs, Analytics, Explorers, Indexers, Security Tools

Builder
Quickstart
From zero to deployed contract in under 30 minutes — follow these steps to get started on QIE testnet
1
Add QIE Testnet to MetaMask
Network name:
QIE Testnet
· Chain ID:
1983
· RPC:
https://rpc1testnet.qie.digital/
2
Request testnet QIE from the faucet
Visit
qie.digital/faucet
, connect MetaMask, and request test tokens.
⚠ The faucet is for QIE testnet only — it will never ask for seed phrases, private keys, deposits, or mainnet funds.
3
Deploy a Solidity contract with Hardhat or Foundry
QIE is EVM-compatible. Use your existing Hardhat or Foundry workflow — just point the RPC to the QIE testnet endpoint. Refer to
docs.qie.digital
for chain details and Solidity tooling notes.
4
Verify your contract on the testnet explorer
Paste your contract address into
testnet.qie.digital
and verify the source code so judges can inspect it.
5
Submit with repo, demo URL, contract address, and track
Sign in, open the submission form, and provide your GitHub repository, live demo URL, deployed contract address, and the hackathon track that best fits your project. Submissions are open from
Aug 1, 2026
to
Nov 30, 2026
.
Starter repos & examples:
Canonical hackathon starter code lives at
github.com/qieadmin
. Additional chain source code is available at
github.com/qie-blockchain
. When in doubt, use qieadmin for hackathon-specific tooling.
Why
Participate?
The QIE Hackathon offers a unique opportunity to showcase your skills and build on cutting-edge blockchain technology.
Deploy on Mainnet
Ship a live product on QIE Mainnet, not just a prototype demo.
Prove Real Traction
Win by showing usage, growth, and measurable user activity.
Earn Milestone Payouts
50% on win, 50% on 90-day traction milestones.
QIE
Ecosystem
Explore the complete QIE blockchain ecosystem and build on top of existing infrastructure
QIE Pass
Digital identity and access management system for the QIE ecosystem
Explore
QIE Wallet
Secure, user-friendly wallet for managing QIE tokens and interacting with dApps
Explore
QIE Stable Coin
Stable digital currency backed by the QIE ecosystem for reliable transactions
Explore
QIE Dex
Decentralized exchange for trading tokens and providing liquidity in the QIE ecosystem
Explore
Build on QIE Infrastructure
Leverage existing QIE ecosystem components in your hackathon project. Integrate with QIE Wallet for authentication, use QIE Stable Coin for payments, connect to QIE Dex for trading functionality, or build identity solutions with QIE Pass.
Projects that effectively integrate with existing QIE ecosystem components will receive bonus consideration during judging.
What Judges Are
Looking For
Understanding our evaluation criteria will help you build a winning project
1
Originality & Innovation
Creative solutions that bring something new to the blockchain space
2
Real-World Usefulness
Practical applications that solve actual problems people face
3
Product Quality & UX
Polished user experience with intuitive design and functionality
4
QIE Ecosystem Integration
Effective use of QIE blockchain features and ecosystem components
5
User Adoption Potential
Clear path to gaining real users and sustainable growth
🏆 Bonus Points
Projects integrating multiple QIE components (QIE Wallet, QIE, QIE Pass, QIEDEX, Oracles) receive additional scoring consideration
Strict
Anti-Abuse
Rules
To maintain hackathon integrity, we have zero tolerance for the following violations
×
Forked/Recycled Code
Code from previous hackathons or existing projects
×
Copied Projects
Projects copied from Ethereum or other blockchain hackathons
×
Simple Clones
Basic copies without meaningful innovation or differentiation
×
AI-Generated Projects
Projects with minimal developer contribution or effort
×
No Working Demo
Projects submitted without functional demonstration or deployment
Immediate Disqualification
All submissions undergo thorough review for originality and development effort. Violations result in immediate disqualification with no appeals process.
